name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Secrecy goes with at least three of Pierce, Pistol, Valet, and Reading.
Cooking goes with either Holloway or Doctor (but not both).
Doctor goes with exactly three of Holloway, Crowbar, Inheritance, and Reading.

hints.text: Suppose Holloway didn't go with Cooking — that hits a contradiction, so it does.
chain: Start by assuming Holloway does not go with Cooking.
From the clue “Cooking goes with either Holloway or Doctor (but not both)” — Doctor must go with Cooking.
Doctor goes with Cooking, so it can't also go with Reading.
Doctor goes with Cooking, but Holloway doesn't, so Holloway doesn't go with Doctor.
…but now the clue “Doctor goes with exactly three of Holloway, Crowbar, Inheritance, and Reading” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
